title: Minimal Vector Logo (DALL-E)
description: Clean minimal vector logo for startup branding, indie SaaS, and design portfolios. DALL-E 3 Vivid style for crisp design.

prompt.main: A modern minimal vector logo for a tech startup called "AURA", featuring a stylized letter A combined with a soft circular gradient shape in indigo and teal, clean geometric design, suitable for app icon and business card, isolated on white background

explained.why: Vivid style for clean graphic design. Better than Natural for logos.

tutorial.intro: DALL-E 3 + Vivid style = clean modern logo. Write as natural language with the brand name in quotes.
steps: Format: A modern minimal vector logo for a tech startup called "AURA" — format + brand name.
Design: featuring a stylized letter A combined with a soft circular gradient shape — mark concept.
Color: indigo and teal — named colors.
Use: suitable for app icon and business card — use cases.
Background: isolated on white background — clean background.
tutorial.tips: For logos: Vivid style + brand name in quotes + use case ("app icon"). DALL-E renders all three well.

crossModel.midjourney: MJ v6.1: "minimal vector logo, AURA tech, indigo teal --ar 1:1 --v 6.1 --s 400".
crossModel.stable_diffusion: SDXL + Proteus, CFG 7, Steps 25. Use Ideogram for text accuracy.
crossModel.dall_e: DALL-E 3, style Vivid. Same prompt as written.
crossModel.jimeng_zh: 极简矢量 logo，科技初创 "AURA"，靛蓝青绿渐变，几何字母 A。

faq.q: Why is my brand name misspelled?
faq.a: DALL-E 3 is much better than MJ/SDXL for text, but still not perfect. Verify before using.
1:1 + Vivid style + simple letter mark + named use case. Reads as "professional logo" instantly.
Vector in prompt + simple shapes. SDXL + Proteus gives best vector output.
